title: About Me
text:
Hi! My name is Dai and I am currently a Cognitive Science student at UCLA with interests in UX/UI design, visual storytelling, and user-centered experiences.
I enjoy combining creativity with research to design experiences that feel both functional and engaging.
Outside of academics, I enjoy art, traveling, and trying new food spots.
